The standard format of SPI half-duplex communication is CMD + [ADDR +] [DUMMY +] [DOUT or DIN].
The states ADDR, DUMMY, DOUT, and DIN are optional, and can be disabled or enabled independently.

The detailed properties of half-duplex GP-SPI are as follows:
CMD: 0 ~ 16 bits, master output, slave input.
ADDR: 0 ~ 32 bits, master output, slave input.
DUMMY: 0 ~ 256 FSPICLK/SPI3_CLK cycles, master output, slave input.
